title: gnidiopsis carinata
intro: Gnidiopsis carinata, commonly known as New Zealand club moss, is a small, club-shaped plant belonging to the family Selaginellaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Gnidiopsis carinata include its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
